scene_name: 纯净白底图 — Clean White Background
prompt: A professional e-commerce product photography image of {{product_name}}. The {{product_category}} is placed centered on a pure white seamless background with soft, even lighting. {{product_description}} High resolution commercial photography, 8K, sharp focus on product, no shadows, no reflections on product surface unless inherent to {{product_materials}}. Clean minimal composition, professional studio lighting, 3/4 angle view showing the product's best features: {{key_features}}. White background fills the entire frame with no edges or gradients.
negative_prompt: busy background, decorative elements, text, watermark, human model, hands, messy shadows, harsh lighting, overexposed, underexposed, lens flare, motion blur, low quality, amateur photography, cluttered composition
style: Professional e-commerce commercial photography, clean and minimal, Amazon product photography standard
composition: Product centered, 3/4 angle or front-facing, occupy 60-70% of frame, rule of thirds, symmetrical balance, product fully visible
lighting: Soft diffused studio lighting, even illumination, no harsh shadows, subtle rim light to define edges
color_palette: Clean whites (#FFFFFF to #F5F5F5), product's natural colors accurately represented, slightly desaturated background
